step2.ptxt: Before working on the fuel system, disconnect the cable from the negative battery terminal.
Never work on the fuel system near fire. Also, never smoke while working.
Keep rubber or leather parts away from gasoline.
When disconnecting a high-pressure fuel line, a large amount of gasoline may spray out, so follow the procedure below.

step3.ptxt: Perform the fuel spill prevention procedure. (see )
Remove the tube joint clip.
Disconnect the fuel tube.
Drain the fuel remaining in the fuel tube.
Cover the disconnected fuel tube with a plastic bag.

atten4.ptxt: Do not damage the fuel tube or allow foreign matter to enter the tube.

step3.ptxt: Place a container under the fuel tube connection.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when removing and installing the injectors.

step3.ptxt: Never reuse the O-rings.
When installing a new O-ring to the injector, never damage it, as this may cause fuel leaks.
Before installation, apply spindle oil or gasoline to the new O-ring.

atten3.ptxt: Never use engine oil, gear oil or brake fluid.

step3.ptxt: When installing the injectors to the delivery pipe and cylinder head as shown in the illustration, be sure to apply gasoline or spindle oil to the places where the delivery pipe contacts the injector O-rings.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when removing the fuel tube connector (metal type).

step3.ptxt: Remove the fuel pipe clamp No.2.
Take hold of the metal connector of the fuel tube.
Rotate SST to align the chamfered part of SST with the retainer position inside the fuel tube connector, and insert SST into the fuel tube connector side.
In the condition above, hold SST and push the fuel tube connector toward SST so that the fuel tube connector retainer rides onto the chamfered part of SST.

atten4.ptxt: The lock of the fuel tube connector retainer is released.

step3.ptxt: Slide SST and the fuel tube connector together toward the fuel tube until a "click" sound is heard, and disconnect the fuel tube.
After disconnecting the fuel tube, protect the fuel tube connector and pipe with plastic bags to prevent damage and entry of foreign matter.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when connecting the fuel tube connector (metal type).

step3.ptxt: Fit the metal connector of the fuel tube along the axis of the engine side until it makes a "click" sound, and pull on it to check that it is securely connected.
Fit the fuel pipe clamp No.2 until it makes a "click" sound.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when disconnecting the fuel tube connector (type A).

step3.ptxt: Disengage the claws and remove the fuel pipe clamp.
Before disconnecting the fuel tube connector, check for mud or other dirt on the fuel tube connector and pipe, and clean them if dirty.
Pinch the retainer from both sides by hand as shown in the illustration, and pull the fuel tube connector out of the pipe.
If the fuel tube connector and pipe are stuck, pinch the pipe and push and pull the fuel tube connector to release it, then disconnect the fuel tube connector.
After disconnecting the fuel tube, check for mud or other dirt on the seal surface of the pipe, and clean it if dirty.
Protect the disconnected fuel tube connector and pipe with plastic bags.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the fuel tube connector or pipe, or allow foreign matter to enter the pipe.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when connecting the fuel tube connector (type A).

step3.ptxt: Align the axis of the fuel tube connector with the axis of the pipe, and push in the fuel tube connector until the retainer makes a "click" sound.
After connecting the fuel tube connector, pull on the fuel tube connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.

atten4.ptxt: The half-fitting prevention connector is designed so that the fuel hose connector cover cannot be locked if the fuel tube is not fully connected.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when disconnecting the fuel tube connector (type B).

step3.ptxt: Before disconnecting the fuel tube connector, check for mud or other dirt on the fuel tube connector and pipe, and clean them if dirty.
Pinch the tips of the retainer from both sides by hand as shown in the illustration, and pull the fuel tube connector out of the pipe.
If the fuel tube connector and pipe are stuck, pinch the pipe and push and pull the fuel tube connector to release it, then disconnect the fuel tube connector.
After disconnecting the fuel tube, check for mud or other dirt on the seal surface of the pipe.
Protect the disconnected fuel tube connector and pipe with plastic bags.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the fuel tube connector or pipe, or allow foreign matter to enter the pipe.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when connecting the fuel tube connector (type B).

step3.ptxt: Align the axis of the fuel tube connector with the axis of the pipe, and push in the fuel tube connector until the retainer makes a "click" sound.
After connecting the fuel tube connector, pull on the fuel tube connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when removing the fuel tube connector (type C).

step3.ptxt: Before disconnecting the fuel tube connector, check for mud or other dirt on the fuel tube connector and pipe, and clean them if dirty.
As shown in the illustration, disengage the 2 claws of the fuel tube connector retainer, push down the retainer, and disconnect the fuel tube connector from the pipe.
If the fuel tube connector and pipe are stuck, pinch the pipe and push and pull the fuel tube connector to release it, then disconnect the fuel tube connector.
After disconnecting the fuel tube, check for mud or other dirt on the seal surface of the pipe, and clean it if dirty.
Protect the disconnected fuel tube connector and pipe with plastic bags.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the fuel tube connector or pipe, or allow foreign matter to enter the pipe.

step2.ptxt: Observe the following precautions when connecting the fuel tube connector (type C).

step3.ptxt: Align the axis of the fuel tube connector with the axis of the pipe, push in the fuel tube connector and push up the retainer.
After connecting the fuel tube connector, pull on the fuel tube connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.

step2.ptxt: After working on the fuel system, be sure to check that there are no fuel leaks. (see )
